sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r3/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: Quality Checks row 16 (check 15) and Internal Quality Checks row 16 (no extra annotation or cell comment); Deterministic Checks rows for check-dockerfiles.py, check-fixtures.py, check-package-manifest-deps-preinstalled.py, check-runtime-deps-in-both-images.py
evidence: task/environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template agent Dockerfile (both SHA256 0a75419e9598ded9317b26bbf0d2b12de0b9b11185fb4c9fed1ca7f3e52467d1), so no template-controlled setting was altered. Every item of the skill's Verify list (quality-checks.md:67) is met: pinned base `FROM node:22-bookworm-slim` (Dockerfile:1); `ENV NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules` (:3) matching the global install of `express@5.1.0` and `better-sqlite3@12.4.1` (:9-12); `COPY instructions/ /instructions/` (:14) and `COPY assets/ /assets/` (:15) with `chmod -R a+rX /instructions /assets` (:16); /app created, git-initialised and holding only .gitkeep (:17-23). COPY sources exist: environment/assets/seed_data.json (valid JSON) and six notes in environment/instructions, matching instruction.md:3 ('six notes in /instructions', '/assets/seed_data.json'). No COPY of solution/ or tests/. task.toml:20-24 sets no docker_image, so the Dockerfile is live. No run-time install: solution/solve.sh:1-38 only checks open DB handles and `cp -a` the app; tests/test.sh launches `node "$APP_ENTRY"` with NODE_PATH (106-111, 162-167) and contains no npm/apt/pip. The golden's server-side requires are only node:path, node:fs, express, better-sqlite3 (solution/app/server.js:2-5), both pre-installed at the exact versions package.json:17-18 declares; the other manifest dependencies (acorn, acorn-walk, @lezer/html, prettier, react, react-dom; vite/typescript dev) are imported only from src/ and ship pre-bundled in public/assets/index.js, served statically (server.js:130-131; public/index.html references only /assets/index.js and /assets/index.css, no remote URL). The verifier image installs the same express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 (tests/Dockerfile:16-22). The public contract is consistent with the image: integration.md:5 says the launch image supplies Node 22, Express and better-sqlite3 through NODE_PATH and that the finished app must not need an install or build step. Weak-app probe: an app that needs `npm install` at launch finds no install step in test.sh and fails, as intended. Conforming-alternative probe: a builder using other frameworks can vendor them under /app/node_modules or prebuild a bundle (integration.md:5,11), so the image does not penalise a conforming alternative. Unpinned apt packages (Dockerfile:5-7) and the tag-not-digest base are template-controlled and a NOTE-only matter under check-dockerfiles.py, not a defect for this row. Limitation: this is a source review; I did not build the image, and raw-evidence-index.json records only scripted golden checks, not an image build or a test.sh launch.
